messages.author: a7f0924a218fb70a
messages.subject: Annotating bar graphs
parts:
Why can't I annotate this bar graph? I can't seem to find a value of y that puts the label on the image!

lu=data.frame(Category=c("xxxx","yyyy"),Area=c(100,300))
p1=ggplot(lu)+geom_bar(aes(x=Category,y=Area),stat="identity")+coord_flip()
p1+annotate("text",x=100,y=1,label=c("llll"))

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: Annotating bar graphs
parts:
Thanks for a good minimal reproducible example.

Answer: because you need to work with the untransformed coordinate
system--that is, you should be supplying ('text', x='xxxx', y=100,
...) to annotate. Or, you can use ('text', x=1, y=100, ...); this is
less clear in my opinion, but produces the same result because
lu$Category is a factor whose first level is 'xxxx'.

Ben
